subject: act-tr
title: ACT.TR.------ALT.C.PG.
description: Chart on book p. 169 (SR(TRS)II-25). ACT-TR (actual transformation) is the subject, with the (C) prefix, "the concept of"; ALT-C-PG (alternative composite progressionalism) is the partner. From the subject: C-ACT (composite activism), AFI-DY and CUL-INFO-DY (cultural information dynamics). From AFI-DY: DYM-F (dynamic functionalism). From CUL-INFO-DY: INFO-F (information focus), with the (CT) prefix, "the criterion of". INTR (interpretation), with the (R) prefix, "the reality of", is on a dotted line from CUL-INFO-DY. BSCF (basic scientific functionalism) is on a dotted line from DYM-F.
